automatic_checks.strict_prefixes: Every proper prefix of a nonempty valid encoding rejects with truncated value under its declared entry/schema and fitting case budgets; zero-width encodings have no proper prefixes.
automatic_checks.trailing_bytes: Append 00 and decode under default limits with the same entry/schema; finish rejects trailing value bytes. Do not let an exact selected bytes limit mask this separate finish check.
automatic_checks.owned_results: Decode from an admitted mutable input view, mutate the caller view afterward, and require returned owned values unchanged; use native-only tests where immutable input types make aliasing unrepresentable.
automatic_checks.exact_subviews: Decode a bounded typed byte subview with unrelated prefix/suffix storage; only the selected view participates.

native_admission_policy: Qualify a rejection at the actual public native boundary when the host value is representable. A statically impossible input may be recorded as a documented type exclusion, not fabricated by a narrowing cast. Fixture-adapter-only validation is not runtime codec evidence.

encoder_error_policy.rust_reference: Assert exact Rust error strings as well as family.
encoder_error_policy.native: Only encode-limit message presentation may normalize between the first sticky byte/allocation limit wording and Rust finish generic byte-or-allocation wording. Preserve the actual direct callback result, subsequent finish result, failure family, sticky state and retained bytes.
encoder_error_policy.forbidden: Do not auto-finish a raw successful callback, replace a callback error with an earlier writer error, clear sticky failures, or fabricate success/recovery in the fixture adapter.
